crossRefs.note: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach…
One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”
They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a…
As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out…
lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the…
where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.
“It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and…
Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt…

parallels.note: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

translations.web: Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
translations.bsb: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
translations.kjv: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
translations.asv: And there came unto him Pharisees, trying him, and saying, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
